neet_che_u19_t00_1.working: Nucleic acids are polynucleotides: their monomers are nucleotides (base + sugar + phosphate). Nucleosides lack the phosphate.

neet_che_u19_t00_2.working: Cellulose is the structural polysaccharide of plant cell walls, so option 2 is correct. The other pairs have their functions swapped: hormones are messengers, nucleic acids carry genetic information, and carbohydrates (not vitamins) are the chief energy source.

neet_che_u19_t00_3.working: Biomolecules are non-living, vitamins are needed in small amounts, and carbohydrates can be structural (e.g. cellulose), so 1-3 are wrong. Proteins are structural and act as enzymes, so option 4 is correct.

neet_che_u19_t00_4.working: A is true: cellulose is a structural carbohydrate in plant cell walls. R is false: carbohydrates such as glucose and starch are major energy sources.

neet_che_u19_t00_5.working: Statement I is correct: polysaccharides, proteins and nucleic acids are built from monosaccharides, amino acids and nucleotides respectively. Statement II is also correct.
